purpose: One source for the owner's UserIO bearer that the native Airlock UI gateway substitutes in mode userio. Closes the HTTP 401 on https://universal-userio.airlock.bezrabotnyi.com/v1/accounts that made the release gate red.
chain: nginx/Caddy -> platform -> app container ui_proxy.go (productUI, admin only) -> UI gateway 172.17.0.1:19419 -> UserIO runtime 127.0.0.1:18093
the gateway reads user_token_files[principal] from ~/.config/airlock-apps/ui-gateway.json, replaces the Authorization header with Bearer <file content> and forwards to the runtime
the gateway loads every token file once at startup, so a new value needs a restart of airlock-ui-gateway.service to take effect

defect.symptom: the owner route /v1/accounts answered HTTP 401 {"error":"unauthorized"} from the UserIO runtime; the release gate check 'universal-userio original UI, assets, API, grants, auth and budget' failed with 'product API missing (HTTP 401)'
defect.cause: the gateway substituted the hand-copied file ~/.config/airlock-apps/ui-userio-owner.token written on 2026-10-09. Its value is not a row of the UserIO api_tokens table and does not match the runtime master token, so the runtime rejected every owner call
defect.why_it_rotted: the owner credential lived in three places at once: the platform binding store (agent_mcp_servers.access_token_ref), the UserIO service env (USERIO_API_TOKEN) and the gateway's own file. Only the platform copy was ever refreshed; the gateway copy stayed frozen at its 2026-10-09 value and the gateway additionally keeps the file content in memory until it is restarted
ruled_out: the platform binding credential was live: POST /api/agent/mcp/userio_owner/tools/call answered HTTP 200 with the owner's own accounts
the second principal was unaffected: ui-userio-oleg.token answered HTTP 200 against the same runtime
the UserIO runtime and the app container were healthy

single_source.value: the owner's UserIO bearer, identical to USERIO_API_TOKEN of the UserIO service and to the platform binding credential. The value is never written into this fragment.
consumers: UI gateway: ~/.config/airlock-apps/ui-gateway.json -> universal-userio.user_token_files['5e438326-6339-4ac8-a328-59dae1d6241f'] points at this file
legacy path ~/.config/airlock-apps/ui-userio-owner.token is a symlink to this file, so no second copy of the value exists on disk
platform binding tooling: ~/.config/airlock-apps/userio_owner.token is a symlink to this file, matching the <binding_slug>.token convention read by scripts/airlock_apps.py

rotation: write the new bearer into /home/roomhacker/.config/airlock-mcp/userio_token with mode 0600 and owner roomhacker
restart airlock-ui-gateway.service: the gateway reads the token files only at startup

checks: the gateway config points the owner principal at the canonical file
the legacy path and the platform binding path are links to the canonical file, not separate copies of the value
the canonical bearer is still accepted by the runtime (read-only GET /v1/accounts on 127.0.0.1:18093)
no token value is printed: only length and a sha256 prefix are shown

verify.observed_2026_10_23: noticeplace ok, universal-userio ok, gptadmin ok, agent-herder ok, grepmesh ok; the unrelated SDK check 'TestPlanRegistrySelectsOnlyPlanBinding' of the airlockplan work fails
